map.足球（控球率/传球成功）统计是做什么的？: What does Soccer Match Statistics do?
map.如何使用足球（控球率/传球成功）统计？: How do I use Soccer Match Statistics?
map.足球（控球率/传球成功）统计适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Soccer Match Statistics best for?
map.控球率/传球成功: A soccer match statistics tool: enter possession, pass-success rate and shots to summarize team technique-tactics metrics for post-match analysis.
map.足球比赛统计：控球率 = 本方控球时间 ÷ 比赛时长 × 100%；传球成功率: Soccer match statistics: possession = own possession time ÷ match duration × 100%; pass success rate = successful passes ÷ total passes × 100%; passes per minute = passes ÷ match duration; compare the two sides by the differences.
map.赛后用控球率与传球成功率定位中场失控环节，调整阵型与节奏。: After a match, use possession and pass success rate to pinpoint where the midfield broke down and adjust formation and tempo.
map.一场比赛的两项核心比率: Two core ratios of a match
map.一场 90 分钟的比赛，本方控球 54 分钟，则控球率 = 54 ÷ 90 =: In a 90-minute match with 54 minutes of own possession, possession = 54 ÷ 90 = 60%; with 500 passes of which 420 succeeded, pass success rate = 420 ÷ 500 = 84%. Read the two together: 60% possession with only 84% pass success usually indicates insufficient midfield distribution quality — plenty of the ball but no effective progression.
map.控球率高就一定能赢吗？: Does high possession guarantee a win?
map.不一定。控球率只说明谁更多拿球，胜负取决于能否把球权转化为射门与进球。控球率明显: Not necessarily. Possession only shows who has the ball more; the result depends on whether possession turns into shots and goals. Dominating possession yet failing to break through usually means the pass success rate or the passing quality in the final third is lacking — a classic case of sterile possession.
map.传球成功率多少算合格？: What pass success rate counts as acceptable?
map.顶级联赛球队整体传球成功率通常在 80%~90%，中场核心球员更高。判读时要区分: Top-league teams generally pass at 80%-90%, and key midfielders are higher. Interpret by zone: sideways passes in your own half naturally have a high success rate, and mixing them with forward passes in the attacking third hides progression quality — real analysis should be split by zone.
map.职业比赛一般由赛事数据商统计。自行统计时可用分段计时法：把比赛切成若干时段，分别: Professional matches are usually timed by data providers. To do it yourself, use segment timing: split the match into intervals, record the periods your side holds the ball and sum them; the error is usually within a few minutes, which is good enough for coaching and amateur post-match review.
